task.title: Scheduling volunteer shifts
task.shortdesc: Publish shifts that volunteers can sign up for, and track their hours.

step.cmd: Click New shift and enter the date, time and number of volunteers needed.
Choose a shift type, such as Dog walking, Kennel cleaning or Adoption event.

info.p: Shift types can require training. Volunteers only see shifts they're trained for.

result.p: Trained volunteers get a notification and can sign up in the app. Volunteers check in and out with the app, and their hours are recorded automatically.
